chapters.chapter_name: Characteristics, protection and commutating circuits of 9
content:  Classify diode, transistor and thyristor family
 Structure and I-V characteristics of various devices: power diode,
SCR, Diac, UJT, Triac, IGBT, MCT and GTO
 Turn on and turn off process of GTO and MCT
 Protections of SCR: snubber circuit, overvoltage protection, over
 Triggering methods of SCR: forward voltage triggering, gate
triggering, dv/dt triggering, thermal triggering and light triggering
 Commutation of SCR: natural commutation and forced
 Method of forced commutation of SCR : load commutation,
impulse commutation, external pulse commutation, line
 Applications of SCR, series-parallel connection of SCR
 Heat transfer of SCR, cooling of SCR
 Three phase uncontrolled rectifier: half wave and full wave
 Derivation of electrical quantities : half wave uncontrolled
rectifier and full wave uncontrolled rectifier
 Effect of transformer inductance on uncontrolled rectifier and
 Single phase controlled rectifiers: half wave and full wave,
 Control techniques of DC-DC converter: time ratio control and
 Step down DC-DC converter, step up DC-DC converter
 Types of chopper: Class A, Class B, Class C, Class D and Class E
 Single phase bridge inverter: half bridge and full bridge
 Method of voltage control: external control, internal control and
 Pulsed width modulation control: Single pulse width modulation,
multiple pulse width modulation and sinusoidal pulse width
 Types of cycloconverter : single phase and three phase, step down
and step up , mid-point and bridge
 Functional block diagrams of an electric drives
 Starting and braking of DC motors
 DC drives: Half-wave converter drive, semi converter drive, full
 AC drives: variable voltage drive, variable frequency drive,
